context7._comment: Up-to-date library docs (Flutter, Firebase, Riverpod, freezed). Free tier, no API key. Use when unsure about latest API.

github._comment: GitHub issues, PRs, repos, code search. Requires Docker Desktop + GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var (scopes: repo, read:org, read:user, workflow). Set token in shell env or .env file (gitignored).

figma._comment: Figma MCP via plugin bridge — no API token, no rate limits. ONE-TIME SETUP: install Figma plugin from https://github.com/vkhanhqui/figma-mcp-go/releases. Use when converting Figma frames to Flutter widgets (/figma-to-flutter).
